set.scene.ceiling.help: Outdoor scans often have specks floating in the sky that turn into invisible walls. Above this height nothing counts as a wall. The scan's height is the one its admin set; custom is yours, set in a panel that shows it on the scan.
set.scene.ceilingM: Custom ceiling: height in scan metres
set.scene.ceilingM.help: The height in the scan's own coordinates, before Scene size: what "Show and set the height" stores for you. 10000 ignores nothing.
ceiling.title: Ignore collisions above
ceiling.explain: Specks floating in the sky become walls the drone crashes into. Above the plane nothing is a wall any more: you fly through the specks. The ground and the buildings below stay walls.
ceiling.effect: {above} of {total} blocks of the walls are above the plane: they no longer count.
ceiling.effectNone: No walls above the plane: nothing changes at this height.
ceiling.off: Off: every voxel is a wall
ceiling.appliedNow: Now: collisions ignored above {h} m (above the start).
ceiling.appliedOff: Now: every voxel is a wall, at any height.
ceiling.note.off: Every voxel is a wall again
